journal_lines: §oTracked the scent through stone corridors. The tunnels narrowed. The prey had not expected to be followed this far.
§aQuarry went underground. §lHunter§a knew the scent. Miner knew the passage. Both needed.
Drove the prey down a side tunnel by closing off the main one with rubble. Miner's thinking. Hunter's timing.
§aChase ended in a chamber with no exit. Good chamber for ore, too. Both jobs finished in the same place.
The prey thought darkness was protection. The miner had been working in this dark for hours already.
§aFollowed the animal in, found ore on the way back out. §lTunnel§a work teaches you to notice everything.
Cave hunt is different — slower, quieter, close quarters. The miner kept the route. The hunter kept the nose.
§aTook the quarry. Surveyed the passage on the way back through. Neither wasted the trip.
